title: Official rerun of the baseline gauntlet for carry, trend and the commodity gap
question: Do the three starting strategies, at their original default settings, beat the S&P 500 under the gauntlet, and is any effect real? This repeats EXP-0002 as an official ledger run so its numbers can be cited.
prior_trials_note: EXP-0001 and EXP-0002 already ran each strategy 12 times (3 strategies, 36 evaluations).
what_would_change_our_mind: Any strategy passing all six A tests would contradict EXP-0002 and the literature, and would be checked for a bug before being believed.
already_seen: Yes. These settings and their exploratory results were seen in EXP-0001 and EXP-0002. This run makes the record official; it is not a fresh test.
